points: Q2 2026 revenue across cloud, SaaS, social and search: $497bn, up 27% year on year
Forecast: more than threefold growth from 2025 to over $5tn in 2031
Google, Microsoft, Meta, ByteDance and Amazon hold 65% of revenue
read: Synergy press release with forecast chart
take: Five US and Chinese platforms already take 65% of this revenue and hold 70% of hyperscale capacity, so concentration and sovereignty pressure keep rising.
title: Synergy: cloud and digital services to pass $5 trillion by 2031
